title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
abstract: arXiv:2611.22115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend. This report describes the design principles and systems engineering behind the series, spanning architecture selection, large-scale pretraining, and reasoning and agentic post-training. We study how sparse activation, attention design, model depth and width, and speculative decoding balance model capacity with computation, memory access, and execution overhead. Our pretraining infrastructure builds on MindSpore HyperParallel, combining topology-aware hybrid sharding, efficient distributed optimizer execution, and coordinated management of long-sequence workloads and activation memory. CPU affinity and core isolation further reduce host scheduling interference. Together, these mechanisms support the pretraining of a 285B-parameter model on 8,192 Ascend 910C cards,

translated_title: 从TeleChat到星4（Xing 4）：基于国产芯片与框架推进前沿智能体模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了星4（Xing 4），这是一系列大型语言模型，通过在昇腾平台上模型架构与训练基础设施的协同进步，延续了TeleChat系列的发展。本报告描述了该系列背后的设计原则与系统工程，涵盖架构选择、大规模预训练以及推理与智能体后训练。我们研究了稀疏激活、注意力设计、模型深度与宽度以及投机解码如何在模型容量与计算、内存访问及执行开销之间取得平衡。我们的预训练基础设施基于MindSpore HyperParallel构建，结合了拓扑感知的混合分片、高效的分布式优化器执行，以及对长序列工作负载与激活内存的协同管理。CPU亲和性与核心隔离进一步减少了主机调度干扰。这些机制共同支持了在8,192张昇腾910C卡上预训练2850亿参数模型。
tldr: 星4系列通过模型架构优化与面向昇腾芯片和MindSpore框架的深度系统工程，实现了在8192张昇腾910C卡上预训练2850亿参数的前沿智能体大模型。
